location_exception_reason: Roof structural fabrication is a service capability, not a location-defined or GI-tagged product. Buyers evaluate fabricators on technical span capability, IS compliance, and material grade—not geographic origin. Location in titles is redundant noise.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Fabricator', 'Contractor', 'Service Provider') in roof structural titles are NOT redundant. A 'Roof Structural Fabricator' differs fundamentally from a 'Roof Structural Supplier' or 'Roof Structural Consultant'—the word signals whether the seller executes design+fabrication+erection (full service) or supplies pre-fabricated components only. Removing the type word leaves the buyer uncertain about scope of work.
